Convert between timeslices and datetimes

Source: R/timeslices.R
timeslice_datetime.Rd

dtm2tsl() labels instants with the timeslice they fall in. tsl2dtm() goes back, returning the instant each timeslice STARTS at – which is what a real datetime axis on a plot needs.

Usage

tsl2dtm(tsl, calendar, year, tz = "UTC", alignment = NULL)

dtm2tsl(dtm, calendar, alignment = NULL)

Arguments

tsl

Character vector of timeslice labels.

calendar

A Calendar, or the name of one ("d365_h24").

year

A single year, or one per element of tsl.

tz

Time zone for the generated instants.

alignment

How real instants beyond the calendar's vocabulary map onto it; see ALIGNMENT_RULES. NULL uses the calendar's own.

dtm

A POSIXct, POSIXlt or Date vector.

Value

tsl2dtm() a POSIXct vector, NA where a label is unknown. dtm2tsl() a character vector of timeslice labels.

Details

Timeslice labels carry no year, so tsl2dtm() needs one. Pass a single year for the whole vector, or one year per element when the rows span several.

Examples

tsl2dtm(c("d001_h00", "d100_h20"), "d365_h24", year = 2021)
#> [1] "2021-01-01 00:00:00 UTC" "2021-04-10 20:00:00 UTC"
dtm2tsl(as.POSIXct("2021-04-10 20:00", tz = "UTC"), "d365_h24")
#> [1] "d100_h20"
